description: Payroll calendar — A full-year payday calendar for weekly, biweekly, semimonthly (15th and last day) or monthly pay, with each date moved off weekends and US federal holidays (to the previous or next business day), the reason it moved, and the months with an extra paycheck. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).

anchor.description: optional known payday YYYY-MM-DD to align weekly or biweekly

day.description: optional day of month for monthly (default last day)

name: time_pay_dates
